title: Sound Bath & Healing Experience
summary: The Rotary Club of Mumbai Wadala East organised a Sound Bath & Healing Experience on 31st October 2026 at the Old Club House, Bhakti Park, Wadala East, promoting mental well-being, relaxation and holistic wellness.
description:
The Rotary Club of Mumbai Wadala East organised a Sound Bath & Healing Experience on 31st October 2026 at the Old Club House, Bhakti Park, Wadala East, promoting mental well-being, relaxation and holistic wellness.

The session was facilitated by Rtn. Sweety S. Merchant, Founder of Aura Connection, who guided 12 participants through a soothing sound healing experience aimed at reducing stress, restoring inner balance and promoting emotional well-being.

The event also served as a fundraising initiative, with proceeds intended to support underprivileged communities and the Club's community service projects.

This meaningful initiative beautifully combined wellness with service, reflecting Rotary's commitment to nurturing healthier, happier communities while supporting a larger humanitarian cause.

Beneficiaries: 12
location: Club House, Bhakti Park, Wadala East, Mumbai, Maharashtra
